hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: For G0002 and G0003: A_i = F[z -> node]; for G0001: A = (F[z -> x] + F[z -> y])/(x - y).
required_assumptions: x and y are independent symbols
x - y is treated as a nonzero formal divisor for the expression

proof_obligations.expected: G0002 == f(z) with z replaced by x
G0003 == f(z) with z replaced by y

hypotheses.scientific_rationale: All three catalog nodes are built from the same uninterpreted function f. G0002 and G0003 are the two point evaluations used in G0001, and G0001 is the sum of those evaluations divided by the symbolic difference x-y. The hypothesis captures this shared evaluation-and-combination structure without asserting a known special-function identity.
